full_prompt_en: A square, finely rendered narrative illustration shows a young woman in a pale blue dress leaning back beneath dense dark foliage. Her upper body fills the center, angled toward the lower left, while her face tips upward and slightly right. Her eyes are nearly closed and her lips part gently, giving the pose a feeling of sudden air and release. A thick mass of brown curls streams outward across the upper left, each strand picked up by small golden highlights. Narrow straps and a softly gathered neckline hold the cool blue dress at her shoulders. The bodice follows the turn of her torso, while the skirt spreads in long, wind-pulled folds across the lower-left corner. Her arms extend behind and beside her, partly hidden by fabric and the crop. Behind her, deep green leaves and nearly black branch shadows make a dense upper canopy. On the right and below, the foliage loosens into pale mossy greens and a soft sandy opening, which gives the figure room to glow. Fine brown contour lines describe skin, curls and cloth folds, while carefully layered color creates subtle volume without losing the drawn character. Warm light enters from the upper right, striking her face, shoulder and the highest strands of hair; cooler gray-blue shadows collect in the dress folds. The background remains mottled and textured instead of sharply detailed, so the moving figure stays dominant. The overall composition is airy and romantic, opposing the pale diagonal sweep of the dress to the dark, finely worked green canopy.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、精细渲染的叙事插画呈现一名穿浅蓝裙的年轻女子，身体在浓密深色树叶下后仰。她的上半身占据中央，斜向左下，脸则向上并略朝右抬起。眼睛几乎闭合，嘴唇轻轻分开，使姿态带有骤然迎风与舒展的感觉。浓厚棕色卷发向左上方飘散，细股发丝各自接住金色小高光。细肩带和柔软抽褶领口把冷蓝色裙子固定在肩上。上身布料顺着躯干转折，下摆以迎风拉长的衣褶铺向左下角。双臂向身后与身旁伸展，部分被布料和裁切遮住。身后，深绿叶片与近黑枝影形成密集的上方树冠。右边和下方，叶影松散成浅苔绿色与柔软沙色开口，使人物能够发光。纤细棕色轮廓线描出皮肤、卷发和衣褶，谨慎层叠的颜色增加细腻体积，却没有抹去线描性。暖光从右上方进入，照在脸、肩膀和最高的发丝上；较冷的灰蓝阴影积在裙褶里。背景保持斑驳有纹理，而非同样锐利，使移动中的人物仍然占据主导。整体构图轻盈而浪漫，以裙子的浅色斜向扫动对抗深绿、细密刻画的树冠。
style_prompt_en: A finely rendered narrative-illustration treatment combines supple contour drawing with layered, almost painterly color. Warm cream and muted gold highlights sit against deep olive and forest-green shadow, while powder blue and cool gray provide a spacious countertone. Curving directional lines create motion; small repeated marks articulate texture without flattening the larger flowing masses. Edges are precise around the focal area but soften into mottled, granular fields at the margins. Light arrives from one upper side, lifting select surfaces and leaving cooler shadows within folds and recesses. A pale diagonal concentration cuts across a dense dark field, giving the frame both decorative intricacy and a sense of open air. The visual mood is lush, lyrical and gently dramatic.
style_prompt_zh: 精细渲染的叙事插画处理把柔韧轮廓线与层叠、近乎绘画性的色彩结合。暖奶油白与低调金色高光置于深橄榄和森林绿阴影前，粉蓝与冷灰提供更开敞的平衡色调。弯曲定向线制造动势；重复的小笔痕刻画肌理，又不压平更大块的流动形体。焦点区域边缘精确，到了边缘则柔化为斑驳颗粒色域。光从一侧上方进入，提亮部分表面，并在褶皱与凹处留下较冷阴影。一团浅色斜向重点切过浓密暗色场域，让画面既有装饰性细密度，也有开阔空气感。视觉气氛丰盛、抒情，带轻柔戏剧性。
theme_en: A wind-swept woman in a pale blue dress beneath dark green foliage
theme_zh: 深绿树叶下，一名穿浅蓝裙的女子迎风仰起头
name: Milo Manara
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
